item.goblincraft.soda.desc: Sean's own brand. Tastes like a thunderstorm. A full meal and Health Boost for 20 minutes.
item.goblincraft.merch.desc: Official Sean merch. It's black. It does nothing. It's drip. Sean's Security leaves wearers alone.
item.goblincraft.glock.desc: Semi-automatic. Sean says it's for 'weather emergencies'. Uses arrows.
item.goblincraft.restraining_order.desc: Joe has to stay 15 blocks away while you carry this. Void if you hit him. Does not cover the Baby Wars.
item.goblincraft.diddy_oil.desc: Slippery. Speed and Resistance for 5 minutes.
item.goblincraft.sixty_seven.desc: Six. Seven. End-game fists. Sean won't say where he got them.
item.goblincraft.baby_bonnet.desc: Joe's gift to veterans of the Baby Wars. Wear it and his babies treat you as one of their own. Sean's Security does not.
